$comment: Nightly budget. Usage thresholds mirror Jarvis (same subscription). Quotas are items per run; llm_calls_max caps a run. Headroom = percentage points left before the nearer usage limit; headroom_scale maps it to a quota factor (only LLM quotas scale). reduced_factor applies when usage is unreadable. spend_caps (D17) are API-equivalent dollars from claude -p total_cost_usd, metered per call: the night cap covers one run date, the week cap a rolling seven run dates summed from data/manifest/_runs.
